title: Standings retain the state suffix in the display label ("Flamengo-RJ")
evidence: src/data.rs:426 clean_display() only trims quotes/whitespace, so the raw home_team "Flamengo-RJ" from Brasileirao_Matches.csv is stored verbatim as the shown name; standings() (src/query.rs:558) seeds TeamRecord.team from that raw value while team_key() (src/normalize.rs:19) strips "-RJ" only for matching. tests/real_data.rs:70 asserts standings[0].team=="Flamengo-RJ", points==90. This breaks canonical-name lookup (_factual.json: 2019 champion expected "Flamengo" -> "no Flamengo row found", factual_accuracy=0.5). NOTE: the standings math is correct and computed from matches (90 pts = 28W*3 + 6D over 38 games), so R9 itself is met; this is a labeling/normalization defect, not a missing capability.
suggestion: Apply the same suffix/alias normalization used for team_key() when choosing the display label (or map the canonical key back to a canonical display name) so standings emit "Flamengo" rather than "Flamengo-RJ".
